description: This file implements the advanced worker functions for an HTTP proxy object, including connection acceptance, removal, query processing, data transfer handling, and event notifications. It primarily manages server socket interactions and transaction records within the HTTP proxy system.

methods.name: BOOL HttpApoPubwoAccept(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PANSC_HANDLE phClientContext)
methods.description: Handles acceptance of a new server connection, allocates buffer for incoming message.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpApoPubwoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket)
methods.description: Removes and cleans up server connection, disassociates transaction record, and manages connection closure based on transaction state.

methods.name: ULONG HttpApoPubwoQuery(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,PANSC_HANDLE phQueryContext)
methods.description: Processes incoming data buffer to determine server communication mode, possibly collecting, forwarding, or processing synchronously.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpApoPubwoProcessSync(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hQueryContext)
methods.description: Handles synchronous processing of incoming data, forwarding data or completing server transactions based on query mode.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpApoPubwoProcessAsync(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hQueryContext)
methods.description: Asynchronous processing stub, not implemented, returns unapplicable status.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpApoPubwoSendComplete(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved,ANSC_STATUS status)
methods.description: Handles completion of send operations, currently a no-op returning success.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpApoPubwoNotify(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,ULONG ulEvent,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Handles socket events such as errors, closure, and resource notifications, managing transaction and connection cleanup accordingly.
